artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer scan of arithmetic-progression parameters \(1\le d<x\le3000\), checking integer area and the predicted two-prime-support family.
Deterministic output of the bounded check: 4,498,500 parameter pairs, 6,434 Heronian pairs, 44 two-prime-support hits, and zero mismatches.

limitations: The theorem is specific to integer Heronian triangles whose side lengths form a nonconstant arithmetic progression. It classifies the minimal possible area-prime support but does not classify areas having three or more distinct prime divisors.
record_title: Minimal prime support in arithmetic-progression Heronian triangles
